mapper.select: SELECT * FROM sys_menu WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 0 ORDER BY parent_id ASC, sort_order ASC, id ASC
SELECT * FROM sys_menu WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 0 AND (tenant_id = #{tenantId} OR tenant_id IS NULL) ORDER BY parent_id ASC, sort_order ASC, id ASC

SELECT DISTINCT m.* FROM sys_menu m INNER JOIN sys_menu_permission mp ON m.id = mp.menu_id WHERE m.deleted = 0 AND m.status = 0 AND m.visible = 0 AND mp.deleted = 0 AND mp.target_type = 1 AND mp.target_id = #{userId} ORDER BY m.parent_id ASC, m.sort_order ASC, m.id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_menu SET sort_order = #{newSortOrder}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{menuId}
UPDATE sys_menu m1, sys_menu m2 SET m1.sort_order = m2.sort_order, m2.sort_order = m1.sort_order, m1.update_time = NOW(), m2.update_time = NOW() WHERE m1.id = #{menuId1} AND m2.id = #{menuId2}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_menu WHERE deleted = 0 AND parent_id = #{parentId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_menu_permission WHERE deleted = 0 AND menu_id = #{menuId}
